rows.commentary: 5.6: Mohammad Sayyam delivers on a length, allowing Aaryavir Sehwag to angle his bat and push the ball firmly toward backward point.
6.1: Ali Raza tests VK Vineeth with a short of a length delivery that nicks past the outside edge and off stump by the absolute narrowest of margins.
6.2: Ali Raza fires another tight ball, and VK Vineeth gets safely onto the back foot to block it out.
6.3: Ali Raza nails a pinpoint yorker that VK Vineeth scrambles to dig out, sparking an immediate exchange of words between the pair.
6.4: VK Vineeth drills a powerful drive straight to the fielder at cover, prompting Ali Raza to march down the pitch for an intense stare.
6.5: Ali Raza locks onto the pads, Vineeth shapes to tickle it away, misses entirely, and immediately directs a flash of fierce self-reproach at the turf.
6.6: VK Vineeth finally gets off the mark with a flick off a fullish delivery, breaking the shackles and avoiding a maiden over.
7.1: Mohammad Sayyam targets outside the off stump with a short of a length ball, and VK Vineeth wisely watches it sail past.
7.2: Mohammad Sayyam pins a length delivery inward, but VK Vineeth stands firm to dead-bat it toward the covers.
7.3: Mohammad Sayyam serves it on a good length outside off, and VK Vineeth taps it gently in the direction of backward point.
7.4: VK Vineeth loses his shape on a slog and top-edges a shortish delivery over the cordon, surviving as third man cleans up on the bounce.
7.5: Mohammad Sayyam pitches full outside off, and Aaryavir Sehwag leans gracefully into a drive aimed straight at cover.
7.6: Mohammad Sayyam lands this very full on the leg stump, allowing Aaryavir Sehwag to flick it away safely toward deep square leg for a single.
8.1: Ali Raza pitches it short of length, and Aaryavir Sehwag softly dabs it down to deep backward point to rotate the strike.
8.2: Ali Raza drops it on a short of length, prompting VK Vineeth to punch firmly off the back foot into the field.
8.3: Ali Raza digs in a vicious bumper that leaps sharply off the surface, entirely defeating VK Vineeth as he fails to control his intended pull shot.
8.4: Ali Raza capitalizes on the extra bounce with another searing short delivery, forcing an awkward glove from VK Vineeth straight through to wicketkeeper Hamza Zahoor.
8.5: Yashbardhan Chauhan does not score off Ali Raza.
16.5: Niqab Shafiq tosses up a flat length on middle, and Anvay Dravid punches off the back foot wide of cover to rotate the strike.
16.6: Niqab Shafiq fires it full on middle, and Arjun Rajput leans forward to push a straightforward single down to long-on.
17.1: Rizwanullah loops it full and wide outside off, drawing Arjun Rajput into a stretching drive that catches only the toe-end before skidding away to a very fine third man for a single.
17.2: Rizwanullah maintains a disciplined channel outside off, leaving Anvay Dravid to stride forward and comfortably shoulder arms.
17.3: Rizwanullah digs it back of a length outside off, allowing Anvay Dravid to drop deep and steer a mistimed cut into the vacant point region.
17.4: Rizwanullah comes from round the wicket, pinning Arjun Rajput with late movement away from a leaden-footed drive.
17.5: Rizwanullah pitches full just outside off, and Arjun Rajput gets forward to thrash an aerial boundary past the bowler.
17.6: Rizwanullah offers a full delivery on off, where Arjun Rajput's wild leg-side hoick relies on a thick inside edge to race to the fine-leg fence.
18.1: Niqab Shafiq tosses one up outside off for Anvay Dravid, whose push is smartly intercepted by a sliding backward point as Arjun Rajput retreats.
18.2: Niqab Shafiq delivers a good length on off, allowing Anvay Dravid to drop back and punch smoothly toward sweeper cover.
18.3: Niqab Shafiq flights it outside off, prompting Arjun Rajput forward to open the face and steer a defensive prod toward a diving slip.
18.4: Niqab Shafiq loops it full outside off, and Arjun Rajput exploits the vacant square-leg region by getting low to sweep it over the ropes on the bounce.
18.5: Niqab Shafiq serves up a full one outside off, which Arjun Rajput drives firmly past the left dive of the cover fielder for a single.
18.6: Niqab Shafiq hits a good length on off, trapping Anvay Dravid into a drive on the rise that picks out extra-cover.
19.1: Ali Raza returns from round the wicket, tempting Arjun Rajput into a big, footless drive that sails straight past the outside edge.
19.2: Ali Raza bowls full on middle, and Arjun Rajput steps forward to push the drive sharply to the right of cover.
19.3: Ali Raza digs it in short of a length on off and middle, but Arjun Rajput's crisp back-foot punch is brilliantly cut off by a diving cover fielder.
19.4: Ali Raza drops it short, and Arjun Rajput rises to the bounce, launching it majestically over wide long-on for a maximum.
19.5: Ali Raza digs it in again, but Arjun Rajput steers it smartly down to the third-man boundary.
30.6: Farhan Yousaf floats it up on the off stump, met with a dead-bat block by Manal Chauhan.
31.1: Rizwanullah delivers short of a length around off, cleanly punched off the back foot by Arjun Rajput to deep point for a single.
31.2: Rizwanullah targets a shortish length, inducing an inside edge off Manal Chauhan's defensive prod to clatter into the pad.
31.3: Rizwanullah serves a full ball on the off stump, softly guided towards point by Manal Chauhan.
31.4: Rizwanullah digs it short and angling into the helmet, exquisitely upper-cut fine past the keeper by a back-leaning Manal Chauhan for a bouncing boundary.
31.5: Rizwanullah keeps it fullish on the off stump, solidly defended from the crease by Manal Chauhan.
31.6: Rizwanullah breaches the hesitant defense of Manal Chauhan, dragging an inside edge onto the woodwork to shatter a 64-run partnership and dismiss him for 11.
32.1: Farhan Yousaf drops it flat, and Arjun Rajput rocks back decisively to pull it over mid-wicket with majestic flair for four.
32.2: Farhan Yousaf watches Arjun Rajput slice a cut past backward point, racing away to deep for a couple that brings him to ninety-nine.
32.3: Farhan Yousaf fires in a very full delivery, blocked with assured calmness by Arjun Rajput.
32.4: Farhan Yousaf pushes another full one back down, stopped sharply by a diving bowler to shut down the single.
32.5: Farhan Yousaf concedes a sharp cut through the point gap, allowing Arjun Rajput to scamper the single, leap in jubilation, and celebrate a breathtaking hundred.
32.6: Farhan Yousaf drops the pace and Yashveer Goud opens the face, guiding it cleanly down to the third-man region for a single.
33.1: Rizwanullah accelerates through his action and sprays it sharply down the leg-side, prompting the umpire to signal wide.
33.1: Rizwanullah attacks a good length and Yashveer Goud meets it solidly, steering the ball firmly into the off-side.
33.2: Rizwanullah tosses it up full and Yashveer Goud leans forward, punching his drive straight towards the mid-on fielder.
33.3: No run for Yashveer Goud off Rizwanullah.
33.4: Dot ball from Rizwanullah to Yashveer Goud.
43.1: Ali Raza targets the channel outside off, tempting Kavya Patel into a square-drive that whispers past the outside edge.
43.2: Ali Raza arrows one full into middle and leg, comfortably nudged into the mid-wicket region by Kavya Patel.
43.3: Ali Raza digs it in short outside off, forcing Kavya Patel to drop underneath the trajectory.
43.4: Ali Raza rolls out a slower off-cutter that Kavya Patel pulverizes through extra-cover for four, bringing up India's two hundred in style.
43.5: Ali Raza attacks the stumps on a short of length, neatly defended from the crease back to the bowler's left.
43.6: Ali Raza misses his yorker with a low full-toss, clipped away for a single after a sharp diving stop at mid-on.
44.1: Mohammad Sayyam extracts sharp lift and away-movement from back of a length, beating Kavya Patel's back foot defense over the top of off.

44.2: Mohammad Sayyam tests the back of a length outside off, drawing a blind back-foot cut from Kavya Patel that cannons off the thick inside edge before Hamza Zahoor pounces with a sharp diving interception to his left.
44.3: Mohammad Sayyam watches in disbelief as a skiers communication breakdown between three converging fielders lets a sitter crash into the turf.
44.4: Mohammad Sayyam hoists a length ball sliding down leg, allowing Kavya Patel to whip it away toward deep square leg and rotate the strike.
44.5: Mohammad Sayyam pushes it full on middle, calmly patted towards backward point by Ishan Sood.
44.6: Mohammad Sayyam bangs it in short of length on middle, safely negotiated off the back foot by Ishan Sood.
45.1: Niqab Shafiq drops it flat outside off, Kavya Patel cuts off the back foot, dragging a bottom-edge that short third man desperately runs down and dives to claw back just inside the rope.
45.2: Niqab Shafiq tosses it full into middle, Kavya Patel clears space with a front-foot stride to drive wide of extra-cover as long-off scampers across to restrict them to a single.
45.3: Niqab Shafiq fires it full onto middle, Ishan Sood steps forward smoothly to whip the delivery away toward deep mid-wicket.
45.4: Niqab Shafiq attacks the stumps with a full delivery, Kavya Patel drives firmly back, only for Niqab Shafiq to fling himself sharply to the right and intercept.
45.5: Niqab Shafiq lands a good length outside off, Kavya Patel swivels onto the back foot and smashes a fierce cut straight to sweeper cover.
45.6: Niqab Shafiq zips a quick, full ball onto middle, Ishan Sood pushes forward to dead-bat it toward cover.
3.1: Mohit Ulva hits the length, and Usman Khan blankets the ball with a straight bat to stifle any thoughts of a run.
3.2: Mohit Ulva angles a good length delivery away from Usman Khan, who pokes into the empty air and misses entirely.
3.3: Mohit Ulva extracts gorgeous away-movement from round the wicket, leaving Usman Khan grasping at thin air as the Indians erupt in vocal support.
3.4: Mohit Ulva attacks the stumps, allowing Usman Khan to stride forward and flick over mid-wicket for three breathless runs.
3.5: Mohit Ulva strays wide outside the off stump, serving up an easy wide to Abdul Qadir.
3.5: Mohit Ulva drops short into the stumps, where Abdul Qadir gets solidly behind the line to block.
3.6: Mohit Ulva delivers a full length that Abdul Qadir plays right under his eyes toward point with supreme defensive technique.
4.1: Ishan Sood tests Usman Khan with width on a short of length delivery, inducing a thick outside edge that races down to third man for a single.
4.2: Ishan Sood loses his radar down the leg-side, firing an unplayable five wides past Anvay despite the wicketkeeper's full-length dive.
4.2: Ishan Sood drops it on a length, anchored deep as Abdul Qadir meets it with a dead bat from the crease.
4.3: Ishan Sood pitches on a good length at the stumps, forcing Abdul Qadir back on the defensive foot.
4.4: Ishan Sood nearly clips the off bail with a sharp inward-seaming delivery that flashes past a watchful Abdul Qadir.
4.5: Ishan Sood drops it short and wide, allowing Abdul Qadir to unleash a ferocious one-handed cut that rockets through the vast expanses of the point region for four.
4.6: Ishan Sood spears a fullish angle into the pads, and Abdul Qadir simply taps it gently toward mid-on.
5.1: Mohit Ulva attacks the off stump with a full length, prompting Usman Khan to push the ball squarely to mid-off.
5.2: Mohit Ulva finds a good length and angles it inward, met by a solid defensive stroke from Usman Khan straight to short cover.
5.3: Mohit Ulva offers width outside the off stump, and Usman Khan times a gorgeous punch past cover that races away to the boundary.
5.4: Mohit Ulva strikes as Usman Khan edges one behind to give Anvay Dravid a catch, ending his 16-run stay.
16.1: Manal Chauhan drops it on a flighted trajectory, and Hamza Zahoor gets right behind it to dead-bat the ball.
16.2: Manal Chauhan zips through a flatter delivery, forcing Hamza Zahoor back to fend it away safely.
16.3: Hamza Zahoor drills it straight back at Manal Chauhan, who spills the chance, allowing a single.
16.4: Manal Chauhan tosses up a full one, and Hasnain Abbas Dar gently nudges it out toward mid-off for one.
16.5: Manal Chauhan pitches it very full, and Hamza Zahoor tucks it securely across toward mid-wicket.
16.6: Manal Chauhan attacks the stumps, but Hamza Zahoor reads the line perfectly to keep it grounded.
17.1: Kavya Patel probes outside off with a short-of-length delivery, cut sharply by Hasnain Abbas Dar straight to backward point.
17.2: Kavya Patel bangs it in short, and Hasnain Abbas Dar retreats to his crease to block solidly off the back foot.
17.3: Kavya Patel serves a full delivery outside off, and Hasnain Abbas Dar drives it crisply through to deep cover for a single.
17.4: Kavya Patel offers a short-of-length ball, and Hamza Zahoor unleashes a monstrous pull high over mid-wicket for a maximum.
17.5: Kavya Patel gets one to move away on a short length, and Hamza Zahoor plays a watchful back-foot defense to cover.
17.6: Kavya Patel targets the channel outside off, and Hamza Zahoor softly dabs it into the off-side.
18.1: Manal Chauhan drops it flatter, and Hasnain Abbas Dar nudges the delivery straight into the mid-wicket region for a dot.
18.2: Manal Chauhan offers a simpler look, allowing Hasnain Abbas Dar to knock it away comfortably and collect a single.
18.3: Manal Chauhan loops up a flighted delivery targeting the stumps, which Hamza Zahoor dead-bats solidly from the crease.
18.4: Manal Chauhan drifts it full and wide, inviting Hamza Zahoor to unleash a crisp sweep behind square that races all the way to the boundary fence.
18.5: Manal Chauhan tosses it up again, and Hamza Zahoor caresses the ball with soft hands down the ground to long-on for one.
18.6: Manal Chauhan extracts more flight, but Hasnain Abbas Dar covers the line accurately to repel the defensive stroke.
19.1: Kavya Patel targets a good length on the off stump, keeping Hamza Zahoor pinned to the crease in defense.
19.2: Kavya Patel pushes it full and well outside the off stump, prompting Hamza Zahoor to wisely watch it sail through to the keeper.
19.3: Dot ball from Kavya Patel to Hamza Zahoor.
31.6: Yashbardhan Chauhan fires it in quick and close to off, and Hamza Zahoor punches it firmly to the right of the bowler.
32.1: Manal Chauhan drops the length back and Hasnain Abbas Dar nudges it crisply into the mid-wicket region for a dot.
32.2: Manal Chauhan gives it flight with a hint of drift, allowing Dar to ease it past Zahoor down to long-on for a single.
32.3: Zahoor defends toward point while Dar's ambitious call for a single is abruptly rejected, sending him scrambling halfway back.
32.4: Manal Chauhan slides one in quicker, prompting Zahoor to sit back and dead-bat it straight to mid-wicket.
32.5: Manal Chauhan tosses it up outside off, and Zahoor smoothly strokes it away to sweeper cover for a comfortable single.
32.6: Flighted close to off stump, Dar anchors himself securely into a textbook forward defense against Manal Chauhan.
33.1: Yashbardhan Chauhan drops it a fraction short outside off, only for Zahoor to crack it straight into the hands of cover-point.
33.2: Zahoor plays it delightfully late against Yashbardhan Chauhan, opening the face to guide the quicker delivery fine for four.
33.3: Yashbardhan Chauhan extracts flight outside off, catching Zahoor's inside half on the forward block toward mid-wicket.
33.4: A clever, slow delivery from Yashbardhan Chauhan grips and turns, catching the inside edge off Zahoor to roll harmlessly to square leg for one.
33.5: Yashbardhan Chauhan gets it short and spinning in, forcing Dar to chop it sharply toward cover-point where the fielder cuts off the run.
33.6: Yashbardhan Chauhan tosses it up around off, allowing Hasnain Abbas Dar to push it down to long-on and keep the strike.
34.1: Kavya Patel serves it fuller and outside off, which Hasnain Abbas Dar steers square on the off-side to rotate the strike.
34.2: Kavya Patel drops it short and outside off, letting Hamza Zahoor use the pace to glide it behind square on the off-side for four.
34.3: Kavya Patel traps Hamza Zahoor on the crease with an in-angler, but the umpire waves away the loud lbw appeal as leg-side angle saves the batter.
34.4: Kavya Patel angles a fuller delivery outside off, and Hasnain Abbas Dar opens the face to ease it square on the off-side.
34.5: Kavya Patel tests him on a length outside off, and Hamza Zahoor smartly guides it down towards third man.
34.6: Kavya Patel pitches it full on off, prompting Hasnain Abbas Dar to drive toward long-on and seal a magnificent century partnership.
45.4: Ishan Sood pitches it full onto the pads, and Niqab Shafiq turns it gently towards the mid-wicket fielder.
45.5: Ishan Sood drops it short of a length outside off, allowing Niqab Shafiq an easy leave.
45.6: Ishan Sood fires in a low full toss outside off, and Niqab Shafiq misses his intended steer toward third man.
46.1: Mohit Ulva rolls out a slower ball outside off, which Hamza Zahoor pushes off the outer half down to third man for one.
46.2: Mohit Ulva lands a full delivery close to off, prompting Niqab Shafiq to prod forward and block solidly.
46.3: Mohit Ulva attacks the channel around off, and Niqab Shafiq leans across to defend only to be beaten on the outside edge.
46.4: Mohit Ulva delivers on a length outside off, and Niqab Shafiq angles it away down to third man for a single.
46.5: Mohit Ulva hits a good length outside off, and Hamza Zahoor guides it past backward point to rotate the strike.
46.6: Mohit Ulva keeps it on a good length close to off, and Niqab Shafiq defends it cleanly toward backward point.
47.1: Ishan Sood serves a full one outside off, and Hamza Zahoor pats it out to cover-point to cross over quickly for a run.
47.2: Ishan Sood sprays it wide outside off, forcing Niqab Shafiq to leave as Zahoor applauds from the non-striker's end.
47.2: Ishan Sood struggles for control from round the wicket, hurling this one miles wide to make it an effortless decision for the umpire with just four runs left to get.
47.2: Ishan Sood pitches it full on leg, and Niqab Shafiq meets it with a disciplined, straight-bat defense.
47.3: Ishan Sood tests the good length on off stump, which Niqab Shafiq deadens into the off-side with cushion-soft hands.
47.4: Ishan Sood digs it back of a length, allowing Niqab Shafiq to ride the bounce and steer it toward backward point.
47.5: Ishan Sood fires in a yorker on leg, requiring Niqab Shafiq to dig it out carefully toward mid-on.
47.6: Ishan Sood angles his delivery into the leg stump, gently worked away by Niqab Shafiq toward mid-wicket.

48.1: Kavya Patel serves a low full toss outside off, and Hamza Zahoor presses across to drive it in front of square, piercing the diving extra cover fielder to seal a three-wicket victory for Pakistan with a magnificent hundred.

summary.text: Arjun Rajput scored 107 off 85 balls as INDU19 posted 208-10, with Rizwanullah taking 3 for 24. Pakistan U19 won by 3 wkts after reaching 209-7, led by top scorer Hamza Zahoor (wk) with 100 off 108 balls against Manal Chauhan who took 3 for 32.
